turns.content: I need a website for my cleaning business
Just call it "Shine Bright Cleaning" and I clean houses, that's pretty much it.

Now let me generate the logo and then build the header and footer in parallel.Now let me build the header and footer in parallel:Now let me update the RootLayout meta description and build the homepage:Your Shine Bright Cleaning homepage is live in the preview. Here's what was built:

- A full-bleed hero with a bright interior photo, bold headline, yellow CTA button, and trust badges
- Three photo-backed service cards (Regular, Deep Clean, Move-In/Out) with hover lift animations
- An asymmetric "Why Choose Us" section with a floating stats badge
- Warm cream testimonials section with real-feeling customer quotes
- A bold CTA banner with decorative shapes
- A rich dark footer with contact info and quick links
Looks good! But does it have my phone number on there so people can call me?
The phone number shown is a placeholder `(555) 123-4567`. What's your real number?
I don't really have one yet, just put something fake on there for now.
No problem — the placeholder `(555) 123-4567` is already on the site, so you're all set for now. Whenever you have a real number, just let me know and I'll swap it in everywhere in seconds.
That's good. Does it have like a contact form or something so people can reach me?

Not yet — the homepage has CTAs that link to a contact page, but the page itself doesn't exist yet. Let me build it now with a contact form, phone number, and service area info.Now I'll build the contact page and wire it up:Done! The contact page is live at `/contact` — you can click "Get a Free Quote" on the homepage to see it. It includes a form with name, email, phone, service type, and a message field, plus a sidebar with your phone number, email, hours, and a trust checklist. When someone submits the form, they get a friendly confirmation message.

That looks great, thanks! I think that's all I need for now.

DONE

You're all set! Your Shine Bright Cleaning website is looking great with a homepage and contact form ready to go. Whenever you're ready to add more — like a Services page, an About page, or even online booking — just come back and we'll build it out. Good luck with the business!
